candidate.blueprint_topic: Management of Care — federal dialysis facility Conditions for Coverage and quality/safety oversight
candidate.educational_objective: Recognize the ESRD Conditions for Coverage as mandatory federal health and safety standards for participating dialysis facilities that encompass clinical care, infection prevention, water/dialysate safety, and quality improvement.

options.A: They establish minimum health and safety requirements for ESRD facilities, including patient care, infection control, water and dialysate quality, and quality assessment and performance improvement.
options.B: They address only billing and reimbursement and do not establish clinical or safety requirements for dialysis facilities.
options.C: They are optional quality suggestions that a Medicare-certified dialysis facility may disregard without affecting certification.
options.D: They apply the same generic outpatient-clinic standards without dialysis-specific requirements for infection control, water/dialysate safety, or performance improvement.

candidate.rationale: CMS describes the ESRD Conditions for Coverage as the minimum health and safety rules that Medicare- and Medicaid-participating dialysis facilities must meet. The federal ESRD requirements in 42 CFR Part 494 include conditions addressing patient assessment and plan of care, infection control, water and dialysate quality, physical environment and equipment, patient rights, personnel, medical-director responsibilities, data submission, governance, and quality assessment and performance improvement. Therefore, A is correct. B incorrectly reduces the regulations to payment, C misstates mandatory certification requirements as optional, and D ignores dialysis-specific safety and quality standards.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Directly supports the ESRD Conditions for Coverage as mandatory minimum health/safety requirements for participating dialysis facilities and supports their scope across clinical care, infection control, water/dialysate quality, and QAPI rather than billing alone.
candidate.source_document_title: End-Stage Renal Disease Facilities — Conditions for Coverage; 42 CFR Part 494
candidate.source_locator: CMS 'End-Stage Renal Disease Facilities': ESRD Conditions for Coverage are the minimum health and safety rules all Medicare- and Medicaid-participating dialysis facilities must meet and are designed to support safe, high-quality, patient-centered care. CMS ESRD facility certification resources/42 CFR Part 494 include dialysis-specific conditions for infection control (§494.30), water and dialysate quality (§494.40), patient assessment and plan of care (§§494.80-90), quality assessment and performance improvement (§494.110), personnel/medical director/governance, and other facility requirements.
candidate.source_version_date: Current CMS ESRD certification/CfC resource set accessed 2026-08-18
